cards.hint: Think of paired pushes in opposite directions
options: the second object exerts an equal and opposite force on the first
the second object stays still with no push back
the first object loses all its motion at once
cards.quote: Whenever one object exerts a force on a second object, the second object exerts an equal and opposite force on the first.
cards.stem: What happens when one item pushes on another item?

cards.hint: Think about steady travel without extra pushes
options: at constant speed
at rising speed each moment
with a curving path always
cards.quote: An object at rest remains at rest, and an object in motion remains in motion at constant speed
cards.stem: How does a moving item keep going if no push acts on it?

cards.hint: Consider weight and strength of push together
options: depends on the mass of the object
stays free of mass and push size
varies only with color and shape
cards.quote: The acceleration of an object depends on the mass of the object and the amount of force applied.
cards.stem: What sets how fast a pushed item picks up pace?

cards.hint: Air goes one way, surface goes other way
options: the wing is pushed upward
the tail stays level in cruise
the nose drops straight downward
cards.quote: The motion of lift from an airfoil, the air is deflected downward by the airfoil’s action, and in reaction, the wing is pushed upward.
cards.stem: When lift air turns downward, what happens in response?
